analysis:
The PR is documentation-only: docs/reference/configuration.md bumps the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and adds a row at about line 414 for DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED, which selects the Gated DeltaNet prompt-window kernel for qwen3_5 family models. The patch excerpt is truncated, so the full row text and any other doc changes are not visible. The supplied units are the base excerpt (lines 519-686) and the head file lines 1-353. Neither includes the new row at head line 414, and the base excerpt does not overlap the changed ranges, so the added row was not directly examined.

In the visible text, no security-relevant control statements change. The endpoint-resumption and logout section (head 137-158) says no local trust is created and no proof lifetime changes. The App Attest worker section (head 211-227) says the opt-ins are internal, exact-`1` qualification flags and are not production configuration. The SSD prefix-cache section (base 586-618) is unchanged. It matches T-041 on the 30-minute TTL, the HMAC-keyed names, and the cache.directory/volume_uuid binding. Debug cache key file handling is documented as DEBUG-only.

The new env var affects only kernel selection, a numerics and performance matter. It is a process-start variable and is not described as forwarded to launchd. I identified no new trust-boundary, attestation, encryption or authorization change. One open question: the new kernel is chosen by a runtime 'probe' path in GatedDelta.swift that this PR does not show. If the code PR introducing it is separate, its bit-exactness against the stock kernel is a correctness matter that the T-007 and T-056 caveats already cover (no per-request computation proof). No threat-model updates are needed from this documentation change alone.
